name: reduction_levelModulus_eq_zero_iff
summary: Place by place: reduction modulo M^c vanishes iff x has valuation at least c at each chosen place; the generator t has valuation 1 there and is 1 elsewhere.

steps.claim: Using that O.levelModulus 1 is a modulus (its second field), the specification of the generator and of the reduction (generator_spec), and valuations: x reduces to 0 modulo M^c = ∏ w_i^c (distinct primes, multiplicity of a power) iff v_{w_i}(x) ≥ c at every chosen place w_i; since v_{w_i}(t) = 1 there (valued_generator) and t is 1 elsewhere, this holds iff v_w(t^{−c}x) ≥ 0 at every finite place w, i.e. t^{−c}x ∈ Ô (mem_Ô).
steps.lean:
O.genIdele⁻¹.1 ^ c * x ∈ Ô E := by have := (O.levelModulus 1).2; simp_all [↓generator_spec, mem_Ô,
  v_inv, AuxPair.genIdele, valued_generator, levelModulus,
  FiniteMultiplicity.multiplicity_pow, FiniteMultiplicity.of_prime_left, (_ : FinPlace E).prime]
